name: Place names by date
note: What a place was called, and when: Salisbury 1890-1982 for Harare. A register is indexed under the name its clerk used in his year, so a search for the new name misses it. Each name is a dated claim with the page that dates it; an undated «also written» stays in the place's own names. Written only through scripts/place_names.py.

statuses.lead: A source gives the name but not the dates: search it, never date a record by it.

kinds.official: The name in official use then
kinds.colonial: Given under a colonial or imperial administration
kinds.historic: A name the place has since lost
kinds.exonym: How another language or country called it
kinds.native: The people's own name, whatever the state called it
